title: Nvidia-backed AI drugmaker Iambic raises $150 million in US IPO
description: The firm, which counts Nvidia Corp. as a shareholder, sold about 9.38 million shares at $16 each, according to a statement Wednesday. Iambic had offered shares for $15 to $17 each, an earlier filing showed.

title: AI boom puts corporate climate pledges to the test as data demands soar
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence is creating a sustainability paradox: businesses want to use AI to become smarter and more efficient, but the infrastructure supporting it requires substantial amounts of electricity. The post AI boom puts corporate climate pledges to the test as data demands soar appeared first on Digital Journal.

title: KOSPI crashes nearly 8%, Nikkei plunges 5% as US inflation shock triggers global AI stock rout
description: Asian markets plunged on Thursday, with KOSPI crashing nearly 8 percent and Nikkei falling about 5 percent, as hotter-than-expected US inflation fuelled Fed rate hike fears and triggered a global selloff in AI and semiconductor stocks.

title: Apple prepares to debut first AI features in China in December after delay
description: Apple Intelligence is expected to arrive in China in December, but the rollout will exclude new Siri AI assistant and other recently announced features as the company awaits final regulatory clearance
